description: Tjaz writes a multiple-choice quiz with its own AI from a description of what it's about, and the source material it's to be made from when there is any, for the people who will play it, and gives back a link to play it alone, in a 3D game or together on a big screen, and to share it. Use this when the user asks for a quiz about a subject, or from material they gave you, e.g. a chapter, their notes or a web page, and hasn't written the questions. Usually ready within a minute; if not, it gives the link where the quiz is being written, and get_quiz tells when it's ready. Tjaz writes it in the language of the description, unless language is given.

description.description: What the quiz is about, in the user's words, e.g. "Vulkaner til 4.b, vi har læst om Island"

difficulty.description: How hard for those who play it. Default medium

explanations.description: Tjaz always explains after each answer why it's right or wrong, so this can be left out

language.description: Optional: the language to write the quiz in, if not the description's: the language's code as Tjaz has it, ISO 639-1, e.g. da, en, ar, uk, and nb for Norwegian

material.description: Optional: the text of source material to make the quiz from, e.g. a chapter, notes or a web page the user gave you or pasted in the chat. Copy its text as it is, not a summary: Tjaz asks about what it says and makes the wrong answers from what learners often get wrong about it. Leave it out for a quiz about a subject. Tjaz keeps it in the user's source material on Tjaz, where they can make more quizzes from it or delete it

material_title.description: Optional, with material: its title, e.g. "Kapitel 3: Vulkaner", which the user finds it by in their source material. Default its first line

players.description: Who will play the quiz. An age group: children (6–12), teens (13–17), adults (18–64), seniors (65+); or, for school, a level: grade0 is the first year of school at about 6 (kindergarten, Danish 0. klasse), grade1 to grade12 the school years after it (grade4 is US Grade 4, Danish 4. klasse, German 4. Klasse, UK Year 5; grade10–grade12 are the last three years of upper secondary school, e.g. Danish 1.g–3.g), then bachelor, master, phd, or nobel for experts. Leave it out when the user didn't say who will play: Tjaz then reads it from the description, as tjaz.com does

public.description: Whether the user wants it on tjaz.com/quizzes, where anyone can find it. A quiz from a chat is saved for those who get its link only; the user can show it on tjaz.com/quizzes from its Share dialog on tjaz.com

tone.description: fun: playful; serious: plain; educational: teaches, with three facts between the questions. Default educational

name: make_quiz

message.description: Why it was refused, or what to tell the user

bigScreen.description: Plays it together on a big screen, everyone playing along on their phone or laptop

edit.description: The editor, for the one who made it

play.description: The quiz's page, to play it and share it

qrCode.description: A QR code of the play link, as an SVG picture

team.description: Plays it on a big screen as one team against cute, silly monsters, everyone answering on their phone or laptop: the more answer right, the better the team defends, and each monster becomes its friend. Good for a class or a group of children

rating.description: The mean rating from 1 to 5, or null under 5 ratings

title: Make a quiz with Tjaz
